column1: # The run-or-type table of session restore (tools/session/sessionlib/classify.py; python3 tools/dev/session_cases.py).
# expect <TAB> flags <TAB> kind <TAB> alias value <TAB> typed line <TAB> real argv (shell words; " ||| " between the tops of a pipeline)
# flags: - none, root (a member runs as root), unclean (the last session did not end cleanly), claude=<id> (a Claude session id was found)
# kind: the hook's `type -t` of the line's first word; "-" in the typed column = the hook wrote no mark (argv alone)
# expect: run | type, optionally "=<command>" for the command that must be handed to the shell
# package managers, root, transfers, system: typed, with or without the hook
# unknown programs are typed (the user's choice, 2026-11-14: fail closed)
# what the argv cannot say: a function, a compound line, an assignment, an alias for more than one command
# the typed word and the running program must be the same thing
# a pipeline read from /proc alone is typed, as a guess
# after an unclean end nothing runs by itself
# Claude Code: a session with an id is resumed by it; a prompt or a permission flag is typed
# CHAINS (the user's review, 2026-11-14: `cd repo; claude -r` and `cd repo; lg` came back as the whole line typed). The commands before
# the running one are done (the shell stands where the cd put it): only the running one counts. flags `w=<word>:<kind>:<alias value>` are
# the hook's triples for the line's command words.
